newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate up, baht stronger late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate up, baht stronger late.

text.p: The Thai interbank overnight rate edged up further from its morning level to 11.50-12.00 percent, the highest level in three weeks, due to high demand for funds to buy dollars, dealers said.
"There were not many deals as dealers focused their attention on the repo market," said one dealer.
The Thai overnight interbank rate which was quoted at around 11.50-12.00 percent late on Wednesday was the highest since November 18 when it stood at around 13.00-13.50 percent.
The baht became stronger against the dollar to 25.549-25.554 from 25.565-25.570 in the morning as the buying of dollar weakened in the late afternoon, the dealer said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium rose to 8.75/9.75 satangs versus 8.50/9.00 satangs in the morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.54 against 25.53 on Monday.
Thai financial institutions were closed for Constitution Day on Tuesday.
